<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Currency and commodities:</strong> The Indian Rupee weakened to 95.40 against the dollar, while domestic gold and silver prices saw a sharp decline on the MCX amid shifting Federal Reserve rate expectations and Middle East tensions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
